component.name: Heard
component.summary: Dictate into any app with local speech recognition

description.p: Heard is speech-to-text dictation for Linux on Wayland. Press a shortcut, speak, and press it again: your words are typed wherever you were typing, whether that's a terminal, a chat box or an AI prompt.

ul.li: Whisper speech recognition running on your own computer, on an NVIDIA GPU when there is one
Text typed straight into the focused window, or pasted when it can't be typed
A small listening indicator with a level meter that never takes focus
Custom vocabulary for names and jargon
Optional stop on silence, sounds, and a tray icon
Searchable history of past transcripts (text only, never audio)

description.p: On GNOME a small Shell extension does the typing. KDE Plasma, Hyprland and Sway are supported with ydotool or wtype.

screenshot.caption: The listening indicator: timer, level meter, stop, send and cancel
Settings: model, language, vocabulary, microphone and output

description.p: First release: local Whisper dictation with typing into the focused window, a listening indicator, history, settings and a welcome screen.
